purpose: Qualify one exact already-qualified SMA, OpenHands boundary, and model-profile tuple across the complete integrated workload with component-attributed evidence.
decisiveQuestion: Do the exact independently qualified SMA, OpenHands boundary, and model profile continue to satisfy their scoped requirements together across all eighteen scenario intents and 96 repetitions?
excludedClaims: Teams event-export or SMA live-shadow qualification

promptCorpusBinding.freezeRequirement: The final accepted E1 manifest must inline or content-address every exact prompt and fixture and must not depend on an unverified mutable path.
